sources.note: Main website. Founded 1995, Melville NY, privately held. EHR + PM for physician practices, hospitals, billing companies. Cloud or on-premise. 20+ years in business.

ONC mandatory disclosure for SequelMed EHR V12. Lists all certified criteria. Notes Data Motion as HISP vendor for direct messaging (monthly fee). Integration fees for immunization/public health registries and lab interfaces. No contractual or technical limitations stated.

Physician practice solutions page. EHR, PM, document management, e-prescribing, HIE, E/M coding. Supports 24+ specialties. User testimonials mention referrals, e-prescribing, remote access, multi-office use.

EHR feature page. Describes all-in-one solution: problem lists, H&P, vital signs, allergies, immunizations, medications, lab/pharmacy orders, diagnostic results/images. Also mentions billing, charges, payments, A/R, ADT, quality management, outcomes analysis. Dashboard across clinical/admin/financial domains.

PM feature page. Automated billing, claim processing, revenue management. Claim scrubbing, eligibility checking, batch processing, enterprise roll-up reporting, document management, EMR integration, workflow management.

Billing company solutions page. Same PM features marketed to third-party billing companies. Nine key features listed including case management, financial management, claim scrubbing, enterprise reporting.

EMRFinder review page. 4-star rating (8 reviews). Lists features: customizable templates, voice recognition, e-prescribing, patient portal, RCM, claim scrubbing, HL7/DICOM interfaces. Cloud-based, multi-platform. Specialties: podiatry, gastro, OB, chiropractic, urology, gyn.

SoftwareFinder page. 4.4/5 rating (9 reviews). Lists integrations: Quest Diagnostics, SureScripts, Oracle, Microsoft, InstaMed. Supported specialties: cardiology, geriatrics, internal medicine, neurology, dermatology, pediatrics, psychiatry, urgent care, orthopedics, physical therapy. Custom pricing.

EMRSystems review. 4/5 stars (7 reviews). Starting price $148/month. Highlights customizable templates, claim scrubbing, HL7/DICOM interfaces, voice recognition. Users praise workflow efficiency and customizable charting. Concerns: occasional downtime, initial customization complexity.
